Online postgraduate open week

From Monday 23 November to Friday 27 November 2026, you will have the opportunity to explore the admissions process, hear from current students, meet academic School representatives and discover what St Andrew has to offer our postgraduate community.

See all events

Postgraduate study at the top university

St Andrews is the top university in the UK and Scottish University of the Year in The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2027.

Join our postgraduate community and access world-leading research facilities and cutting-edge resources. Our taught Masters degrees and flexible online courses allow you to achieve your potential and advance your career.

Explore Masters study Online Masters

Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews

Great universities never stand still. They must take the lead as society’s engines of innovation and change, and St Andrews needs to be at the forefront.

Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews aims to raise £300 million to achieve this ambition through a number of the key projects. 

With your support, we can make waves and shape the future not only of our University, but of our world.

More about the campaign

Featured news

All news

Get set for winter celebrations

Winter graduation ceremonies to celebrate students, honorary graduates, and award recipients.

Professor's research post

Professor Christopher Smith is named Executive Chair of Research England and Global Partnerships.

New Rector elected

St Andrews graduate Dr Arthur Bernhoff was elected after students turned out to vote in record numbers.

Events at St Andrews

The University of St Andrews hosts a vibrant mix of events, from academic lectures and research conferences to concerts, exhibitions and cultural festivals.

Whether engaging in discussions, celebrating traditions or enjoying live performances, there’s always something to experience.

All upcoming events

Race Equality Charter award for St Andrews

The University has achieved an AdvanceHE Race Equality Charter (REC) Bronze Award in recognition of its work to improve the representation, progression and success of Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic people at St Andrews.

Race Equality Charter
